reason: Paused cost payments: PendingCostMoveResume::CounterAdditionUnlessPayment gains unpaid_suffix (UnpaidCostSuffix: the unpaid legs of a paused unless effect-cost and their payer) and PendingContinuation gains head_payment_origin (ResolutionPaymentOrigin: a queued PayCost remainder resumes a payment already chosen). An older peer drops both keys, settling a paused multi-leg cost with its later legs unpaid and re-gating a latched remainder as a fresh choice. PendingCostMoveResume also gains ReplacementMayCostInnerChoice (an accepted entry MayCost parked while its leg's own replacement choice is answered), which an older peer cannot decode.
